selection.ownership: Feathery (San Francisco, United States; 2261 Market Street Suite 4263). Global forms API; this recipe pins the documented US default host api.feathery.io.

research.searchCoverage: Official Feathery REST authentication (Authorization: Token), GET /api/account/, GET /api/form/, GET /api/form/<form_id>/, GET /api/field/hidden/, GET /api/user/, US Feathery identity, and dated incident search (Feathery + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. No qualifying platform incident found in reviewed coverage; this is not a breach-free claim.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to GET /api/account/, matching the pinned validator and official Retrieve Account Information docs. Host is the documented US default api.feathery.io; regional api-ca/api-eu/api-au hosts are not caller-supplied. Returns raw Feathery JSON under data.

GET /api/form/. Optional Composio tags array is serialized as a comma-separated tags query parameter (official AND filter). Official active filter is omitted. Returns raw Feathery JSON array under data.
Uses official Retrieve a Form Schema path GET /api/form/{form_id}/ rather than the pinned source /api/form/{form_id}/schema/. Returns raw Feathery JSON under data.
GET /api/field/hidden/ matching official List Hidden Fields. Deprecated /api/form/hidden_field/ is not used. Returns raw Feathery JSON array under data.

Admits optional created_after, created_before, filter_field_id, and filter_field_value. Native templates omit the paired required-together constraint; Feathery rejects an unpaired filter. Returns raw Feathery JSON array under data.
GET /api/account/.
Returns raw Feathery JSON under data unless the official DELETE body is empty, in which case the envelope is {success: true}.
The upstream user-agent is not sent. Host is the documented US default api.feathery.io.

forms.get.description: Retrieve the complete schema for one Feathery form.
forms.get.title: Get form schema

forms.list.description: List Feathery forms for the authenticated account, optionally filtered by tags. Maps to FEATHERY_FORM_LIST.

tags.description: Only return forms that have all of these tags. Sent as a comma-separated tags query parameter.

forms.list.title: List forms

healthcheck.description: Validate the Feathery API key by retrieving account information.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

hidden-fields.list.description: List hidden fields configured in the Feathery account.
hidden-fields.list.title: List hidden fields

users.list.description: List Feathery users with optional creation-time or field-value filters. Maps to FEATHERY_USER_LIST.

filter_field_id.description: ID of a form or hidden field to filter users by. Use with filter_field_value.

users.list.title: List users

account.get.description: Get the Feathery team name and list of accounts. Maps to FEATHERY_ACCOUNT_GET_INFO.
account.get.title: Get account info

account.edit.description: Edit an existing account's role and permissions. Maps to FEATHERY_ACCOUNT_EDIT. Official PATCH /api/account/ accepts an array of account objects.

email.description: Email of the account to edit. Required if account_id is not provided.

account_id.description: UUID of the account to edit. Required if email is not provided.

account.edit.title: Edit Feathery account

documents.fill.description: Fill or sign a Feathery document template and return a file URL. Maps to FEATHERY_DOCUMENT_FILL_TEMPLATE.

document.description: UUID of the document template to fill.

field_values.description: Mapping of field IDs to values to populate in the document.

signer_email.description: Email address to route the filled document for signature.

user_id.description: Associate an existing Feathery user with the generated document.

documents.fill.title: Fill or sign document template

documents.envelopes.list.description: List generated document envelopes by document or user ID. Maps to FEATHERY_DOCUMENT_LIST_ENVELOPES.

id.description: Document ID when type is document; user ID when type is user.

documents.envelopes.list.title: List document envelopes

hidden-fields.create.description: Create a hidden field. Maps to FEATHERY_FORM_CREATE_HIDDEN_FIELD. Composio field_id is sent as official id.

field_id.description: Unique identifier for the new hidden field. Must not already exist.

hidden-fields.create.title: Create hidden field

forms.delete.description: Permanently delete a form. Maps to FEATHERY_FORM_DELETE. Official DELETE requires confirm_delete true in the JSON body and returns no payload.

form_id.description: Unique identifier of the form to delete. Use List Forms to obtain it.

confirm_delete.description: Safety confirmation. Must be true to proceed with deletion.

forms.delete.title: Delete form

logs.api-connector-errors.list.description: List recent API connector error logs for a form. Maps to FEATHERY_LOG_LIST_API_CONNECTOR_ERRORS.

form_id.description: ID of the form to retrieve error logs for.

start_time.description: Only return errors after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_time.description: Only return errors before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

logs.api-connector-errors.list.title: List API connector errors

logs.email-issues.list.description: List email bounce and complaint events. Maps to FEATHERY_LOG_LIST_EMAIL_ISSUES.

start_time.description: Only return events at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_time.description: Only return events before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

logs.email-issues.list.title: List email issues

logs.emails.list.description: List recently sent emails for a form. Maps to FEATHERY_LOG_LIST_EMAILS.

form_id.description: ID of the form to list email logs for.

start_time.description: Only return emails sent after this time.

end_time.description: Only return emails sent before this time.

logs.emails.list.title: List email logs

logs.quik-requests.list.description: List recent Quik integration request logs for a form. Maps to FEATHERY_LOG_LIST_QUICK_REQUESTS.

form_id.description: ID of the form whose Quik logs to retrieve.

start_time.description: Only return requests made after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_time.description: Only return requests made before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

logs.quik-requests.list.title: List Quik request logs

users.create-or-fetch.description: Create a new Feathery user or fetch an existing one by ID. Maps to FEATHERY_USER_CREATE_OR_FETCH.
users.create-or-fetch.title: Create or fetch user

users.delete.description: Delete a specific user by ID. Maps to FEATHERY_USER_DELETE. Official DELETE returns no payload.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user to delete.

users.delete.title: Delete user

users.data.get.description: Retrieve stored field data for a user, or all field definitions when id is omitted. Maps to FEATHERY_USER_GET_ALL_DATA. Official path is GET /api/field/.

id.description: User ID to filter fields for a specific user.

users.data.get.title: Get all user data

users.session.get.description: Get a user's form session and progress. Maps to FEATHERY_USER_GET_SESSION.

user_id.description: Unique user identifier to fetch session for.

users.session.get.title: Get user session

workspaces.login-token.generate.description: Generate a login JWT for a Feathery workspace account. Maps to FEATHERY_WORKSPACE_GENERATE_LOGIN_TOKEN.

account_id.description: UUID of the account to authenticate. Obtain from Get Account Info.

workspaces.login-token.generate.title: Generate workspace login token
